svg.text: Axonometric 1:4, seen from the door side
top, 18 x 382 x 382, cut from board 5
bottom, 18 x 382 x 382, cut from board 5
Side view 1:10 with a visitor 1.75 m tall

Pedestal 418 x 418 x 1200, with the model 418 x 418 x 1688. Each side laps the edge of the next and is screwed into it; top and bottom panels sit inside the sides, flush with their ends, and are screwed through the sides. Circles: board section and board code. The bottom panel carries the ballast.
